details: I have been on VRChat for 4 years, and your entire VRChat Plus subscription model is the most stupidest thing ever. Why on earth do I need to pay real money every single month for basic game features that should be completely free?Locking EVERY SINGLE FEATURE behind a recurring $4.99 monthly paywall is pure corporate greed. You have locked away:The official 2D profile picture icons [1, 2]The ability to save more than 25 avatars, forcing people to pay just for avatar slots [1, 2]Creating custom invite messages and personalized status badges [1, 2]The gallery feature to share actual pictures in-game [1]Custom nameplate icons and skin backgrounds [2]Early access to basic tech and testing queues [2]People nowadays can't even afford basic things, let alone a monthly subscription just to use standard game features that require zero effort from you to provide. You know this is a complete rip-off. Every other platform on earth lets users customize their accounts, save their content, and interact with features for free, but you choose to gatekeep all of it just to squeeze cash out of a community that has supported you for years. I hope you realize how anti-player and exhausting this is. Stop treating us like cash cows, unlock the avatar slots, unlock the menus, and make every single one of these basic features free for everyone now.
title: To the VRChat Developers
